== Card credits ==
Matt Lutz is credited with the original concept of one Players Committee [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Set 16]] (released 3 September 2021).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay)|•Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay)]] || [[Virtual Set 16]] || 3 September 2021 || "Original concept by Kendall Halman & Matt Lutz"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Matt Lutz|Matt Lutz]] on [[Card Credits]].
